title: 第20章 班长，你有点儿上火了
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “科目，正步行进与立定！”“当听到，正步走的口令时，左脚向正前方踢出约七十五厘米！”“腿要绷直，脚尖下压，脚掌与地面平整，离地面约二十五厘米......”升旗台前，水泥路面上，班长周凯东正在演练如何正步走。正步走，齐步走，跑步走并称三大步伐。与整理着装，报数，跨立，停止间转法等训练一样，同属于队列训练组成部分。这也是每一名军人必须要掌握的基本功，会在往后军旅生涯中会反复出现。虽然陆阳在入伍前，接受过堂哥和他的战友们指导练习，但只是简单过一遍，连入门皮毛都算不上。不偏不倚的说，周凯东的正步，要比堂哥他们走的好太多太多。不仅眼神锐利，出脚干脆利落，鞋底落在水泥上的声音也铿锵有力；动作行云流水，赏心悦目。都说看一个兵的好坏，就看他基本功扎实不扎实，这番话也在周凯东这个三期老兵身上得到验证。陆阳笃定，班长在他们老部队绝对是个兵王，最次也得是尖兵。“动作看清楚了嘛？”“下面，你们走一遍。”演示完，周凯东后退几步拉开距离，让新兵朝着他这边正步走。“停停停，走的什么乱七八糟，重来！”重来一遍，周凯东依旧很不满意。甚至毫不客气的说他们像是一群刚破壳的鸭子，滑稽的可笑。尽管陆阳走的很认真，但一个班一起踢正步，只要有一个人动作慢了点没跟上节奏，整体感就会差很多。一遍，两遍，三遍，踢的所有人脚都麻了，却依旧没能达到班长的要求。尤其是孔垄，不知道是因为开小差，还是走神的缘故，竟一不小心顺拐了。气的周凯东摘下帽子就砸过去，像是发电报那样冲着他疯狂问候。“我就想不明了，一个正步走就这么难，都是一帮猪脑子？”“队列训练到现在了还没搞定，你们自已好意思吗？”“看看人家六班，看看人家八班，都已经开始教下面内容了！”“你们一个个的能不能给我长点脸，能不能让我省点心，能不能？！”“能！”“能个屁！”面对众人的齐声回应，周凯东依旧没有任何好脸色。训练状态下，简直像个狠毒后妈，完全不讲道理，天王老子来了都得挨俩大嘴巴。私底下则完全判若两人，能开得起玩笑，性格也随和很多。陆阳甚至怀疑，班长是不是患有严重的精神分裂。不然怎么能够在两个人格之间，切换的如此丝滑？周凯东大吼：“光说不练假把式，能，不是靠嘴巴喊，是要靠实际行动！”“上周的内务卫生流动红旗没拿到就算了，毕竟你们就那叼水平。”“但军事训练流动红旗，必须给我拿一面回来，听明白了吗？”“是！”部队里的流动红旗分三种。分别是内务卫生，军事训练，作风纪律。上周内务卫生检查，三班整体表现马马虎虎，尽管陆阳内务水平还不错，但也仅仅代表他个人。流动红旗的评选，考察的是整个班的平均水平，一枝独秀根本起不到效果。原本，陆阳是希望在周一卫生检查的时候，帮着内务不好的整一整被子。看看能不能用临时抱佛脚的方式，其他班竞争一下，但却被周凯东阻止了。理由也很简单：你帮了他们，他们会产生依赖，凡事都会指望你，平时就不更会认真叠了。当兵，不是糊弄，更不能为了一面流动红旗就做做样子。如果做人都不能脚踏实地，那在部队绝对走不长。陆阳，班长知道你是好心，但好心不能滥用。当兵是一门学问，当班长更是如此，以后如果你当上班长，就会明白我说的什么意思。当时听完周凯东的话，陆阳立马茅塞顿开，同时也感叹老兵们带兵的辛苦和不易。其实，老兵班长之间其实也有属于他们的考核制度，就是流动红旗。流动红旗拿的越多，新训结束后这个班长就越是容易被评优评奖。至于，为什么周凯东没有提及“作风纪律”流动红旗？因为丁腾飞的原因，那面红旗在未来很长一段时间内，可能都和三班无缘了。周凯东用口令简单整了整队伍，严肃说道：“军人，百炼成钢！一遍不行就十遍，十遍不行就百遍！”“这关过不去，后头的咱都不用学了，就在这死磕！”“待会还走不好，那就给我分解练习，一令一动！”听到“一令一动”这四个字，包括陆阳在内的所有人，都本能的心生恐惧。前不久他们刚刚经历过，简直就是噩梦一般的存在。所谓一令一动，就是一个口令，一个动作。通俗来说，就是让他们像定格动画那样，逐帧逐帧的训练。最可怕的地方在于，周凯东会在喊完一个口令之后，就变成哑巴。新兵们只能单脚摆臂姿势一直站着，可能是两分钟，也可能是五分钟，甚至可能是十分钟。为了不遭受这样的酷刑，这遍三班全体都认真了起来，就连吊儿郎当的丁腾飞严肃了点。虽然他对这个班没什么归属感，对于军人的身份更没有丝毫认同，甚至连当兵都是家里硬逼着来的。但吃一堑长一智，关禁闭的这些天他想了很多，也意识到自已可能有些太高调了。他现在只想随便混混，得过且过；不想给自已找什么不自在，更不想被老兵们一遍遍搞心态。在周凯东近乎严苛的要求下，这遍果然要比之前效果好很多。唯一不协调的，就是丁腾飞的踢腿，始终比旁人慢半拍。“丁腾飞，踢脚动作有点慢了，要跟上节奏。再走五遍，结束让大家喝水休息。”“来听口令，向后转，正步...走！”……解散休息期间，陆阳去上了个厕所。旗台距离宿舍楼，相对于训练场的大厕所更近一些。最重要的是，卫生状况比起大厕所要好很多，毕竟那儿去得人太多。尽管现在天挺冷的，每天也都会有人打扫，但上百童男的骚刚之气，还是会非常辣眼睛。白天可能还好点，尤其是到了晚上，每次陆阳都得憋着口气，争分夺秒的进去解决。所以相比之下，宿舍楼内厕所简直干净卫生的一塌糊涂。陆阳站在台阶上，滑动解锁准备开闸放水，周凯东忽然从外头走了进来。然后，就这么水淋淋的站到他旁边，整得陆阳浑身难受。WTF？！你难道不懂厕所社交的基本礼仪？不知道男同志尿尿，必须得隔开一段距离的嘛？既然如此，那得罪了！陆阳先是低头轻笑一声，然后调侃道：“班长，你有点上火，得多喝水。”周凯东眼皮子直跳：好小子……！解完手出来，陆阳有种大仇得报的快感。刚要溜之大吉被周凯东叫住，还掏出一包烟拍在他手里。“拿着。”“班长，我不抽烟的？”“不是给你抽的，是让你给别人抽。”见陆阳不理解，周凯东拉着他来到外头走廊，手指远处旗台。顺着他手指方向，能够明显看到三班休息位置，有个人被独立出去了。那人，正是丁腾飞。丁腾飞不在的这两天，大家相处融洽，过得很安逸。冷不丁的说回来就回来，加上他本就不讨喜的性格，被孤立也是理所应当的事。周凯东说：“丁腾飞再怎么不讨喜，始终是三班的一部分，你们始终是一个集体，懂我什么意思吗？”陆阳看了眼手上的烟：“你是想，我找他谈谈？”周凯东嗯了一声：“看得出来，这小子怨上我了，对我有意见，我找他谈话指定不会听。”“指导员也做过思想工作，他都表现得比较多敷衍了事。”“你跟他毕竟是老乡，又都是新兵，容易找到话题。”陆阳问：“那要是我找也没效果呢？”周凯东拍拍他：“先试试看吧，死马当活马医吧。实在不行，下连能只能给他分到生产基地养猪去，到那他想祸害谁祸害谁。”部队生产基地基本上不用训练，日常就是养猪种菜。那里被称为好兵的地狱，孬兵的天堂。只有实在无药可救的新兵，才会在下连时候被分配到那。但陆阳知道，现在的丁腾飞应该最想去的地方，就是那儿了。舒舒服服混两年，吃好喝好还不用训练，义务兵服役期到了赶紧走人。但，至少在此之前，不能让他影响到整个三班拿荣誉，更不能影响到自已的训练提升进度。系统得不停的学习新知识才能够加倍提升身体属性，始终卡在这不上不下的，整的陆阳也很难受。“我试试吧。”“嗯。”周凯东拍拍他，然后先走了。陆阳低头看了眼袖子上的水渍，眼皮子抽了抽。这玩意儿是水是尿，班长先前出来，洗手了吗？原本，陆阳是准备把东西揣口袋，但考虑烟盒放在裤兜里实在扎眼，而且会影响到训练。想了想，他还是决定把东西放回宿舍，然后再返回的训练场。可他前脚刚走，没多久连长和指导员后脚就朝着这边过来了。手里拿着登记簿和塑料袋，准备趁着没人的时候，来一次突击内务检查。高峰雷厉风行的说道：“这次除了内务卫生，重点就是检查违禁品！”“他奶奶的，昨晚上巡夜，七班有个小子居然偷偷躲在被窝里用mp3看小说，那么小的字也不怕把眼睛看瞎了！”“我倒是要看看，今回能搜出多少违禁品？尤其是那些个偷偷藏烟，藏电子产品的，一旦抓到严惩不贷！”......中午吃饭没见着连长和指导员，这让新兵们感觉事有蹊跷。正在往宿舍楼走着，忽然就看到一床床被子从窗户里被丢出来。自由落体一般的摔在地上，成了一具具惨不忍睹的“尸体”。看到这一幕的新兵目瞪口呆，齐刷刷转向各自班长。班长们也是头皮发麻，顿感大事不妙：“突击内务检查！”周凯东扭头盯着自已班上新兵，脸煞白：“你们，没藏什么违禁品吧？别在这时候搞我心态啊！”陆阳都冷汗直流，先前他顺手把烟放到储物柜里，哪知道会突然来这么一手？这会儿估计已经被查出来了！完犊子，这回怕是凶多吉少了......
content_en: "Subject, goose-stepping and standing!" "When you hear the command to goose-step, kick your left foot forward about seventy-five centimeters!" "The legs should be straight, the toes pressed down, the soles of the feet should be flat with the ground, about twenty-five centimeters above the ground..." In front of the flag-raising platform, on the cement road, squad leader Zhou Kaidong was practicing how to goose-step.Goose-stepping, walking in step and running are called the three major steps.Training such as dressing up, counting, standing astride, stopping and turning, etc., are all part of the queue training.This is also a basic skill that every soldier must master, and will appear repeatedly in his future military career.Although Lu Yang received training from his cousin and his comrades before joining the army, it was only a brief experience and was not even an introduction.To be fair, Zhou Kaidong's goose steps were much better than those of his cousin and the others.Not only are his eyes sharp, but his kicks are crisp and neat, and the sound of the soles landing on the cement is also sonorous and powerful; his movements are smooth and smooth, which is pleasing to the eye.It is said that the quality of a soldier depends on whether his basic skills are solid. This statement has also been verified by Zhou Kaidong, a veteran of the third period.Lu Yang was sure that the squad leader was definitely the king of soldiers in their old army, and at the end of the day he had to be the top soldier."Did you see the movements clearly?" "Next, you guys walk through it again." After the demonstration, Zhou Kaidong took a few steps back to distance himself, and asked the recruits to walk in a goose-step direction towards him."Stop, stop, what a mess you walked, let's do it again!" After doing it again, Zhou Kaidong was still very dissatisfied.They were even bluntly said to be like a group of ducks that had just hatched from their shells, which was ridiculous.Although Lu Yang walked very seriously, if a class were to goose-step together, as long as one person moved a little slower and failed to keep up with the rhythm, the overall feeling would be much worse.Once, twice, three times, everyone's feet were numb, but they still failed to meet the squad leader's requirements.Especially Kong Long, he didn't know whether it was because he deserted or was distracted, but he accidentally took the turn.Angry, Zhou Kaidong took off his hat and threw it at him, greeting him frantically as if sending a telegram."I just don't understand. It's so difficult to goose-step. Are they all pig brains?" "You haven't finished the queue training yet. Are you embarrassed?" "Look at Class 6 and Class 8. They have already started teaching the following content!" "Can you one by one give me a little more face? Can you make me worry less?"In the training state, she is like a vicious stepmother, completely unreasonable, and even when the king of heaven comes, I will be slapped by two big mouths.Privately, he is completely different. He can joke and has a much more easy-going personality.Lu Yang even suspected that the monitor was suffering from severe schizophrenia.Otherwise, how could you switch between the two personalities so smoothly?Zhou Kaidong yelled: "You can just talk without practicing tricks. It's not about shouting, it's about actual actions!" "It's okay if you didn't get the mobile red flag for internal health last week. After all, you are just that good." "But for military training mobile red flags, you must bring one back to me. Do you understand?" "Yes!" There are three types of mobile red flags in the army.They are internal hygiene, military training, and style and discipline.Last week's internal affairs inspection showed that the overall performance of the third shift was so-so. Although Lu Yang's internal affairs level was not bad, it only represented him personally.The selection of flowing red flags examines the average level of the entire class, and a single standout will not be effective at all.Originally, Lu Yang hoped to help tidy up the quilt for those with poor housekeeping during the health inspection on Monday.He wanted to see if he could improvise and let other classes compete, but he was stopped by Zhou Kaidong.The reason is also very simple: if you help them, they will become dependent and count on you for everything, and they will not take it seriously.Being a soldier is not about fooling around, let alone just showing off for the sake of a floating red flag.If you can't keep your feet on the ground as a person, you will definitely not last long in the army.Lu Yang, monitor knows that you have good intentions, but good intentions should not be abused.Being a soldier is a science, and being a squad leader is even more so. If you become a squad leader in the future, you will understand what I mean.After listening to Zhou Kaidong's words, Lu Yang immediately became enlightened. At the same time, he also lamented the hard work and difficulty of the veterans leading the troops.In fact, veteran squad leaders actually have their own assessment system, which is the mobile red flag.The more mobile red flags you get, the easier it will be for the squad leader to be evaluated for excellence and awards after the new training.As for why Zhou Kaidong didn’t mention the “style and discipline” red flag?Because of Ding Tengfei, that red flag may not be associated with Class 3 for a long time in the future.Zhou Kaidong simply organized the team with a command, and said seriously: "Soldiers, a hundred times makes steel! If you can't do it once, do it ten times. If you can't do it ten times, do it a hundred times!" "If you can't pass this level, we won't have to learn the rest, just keep fighting here!" "If you still can't do it later, break it down and practice for me, one order at a time!" Hearing the words "one order, one move", everyone, including Lu Yang, instinctively felt fear.They had just experienced it not long ago, and it was like a nightmare.The so-called "one command and one movement" refers to a command and an action.In layman's terms, it means training them frame by frame like stop-motion animation.The most terrifying thing is that Zhou Kaidong will become mute after shouting a password.The recruits can only stand with one leg swinging their arms, which may be two minutes, five minutes, or even ten minutes.In order not to suffer such torture, all the third class became serious this time, even Ding Tengfei, who was just doing nothing, became a little more serious.Although he has no sense of belonging to this class, and he has no recognition of his identity as a soldier. Even becoming a soldier was forced by his family.But he learned a lot from the experience. He thought a lot during these days of confinement and realized that he might be a little too high-profile.Now he just wants to hang out and get by; he doesn't want to make himself uncomfortable, and he doesn't want to be manipulated by veterans over and over again.Under Zhou Kaidong's almost strict requirements, the effect this time was much better than before.The only uncoordinated thing is that Ding Tengfei's kicks are always half a beat slower than others."Ding Tengfei, your kicking is a bit slow. You have to keep up with the rhythm. Walk five more times. At the end, let everyone drink water and rest." "Come and listen to the command, turn back, goose... go!"... During the break, Lu Yang went to the toilet.The flag stand is closer to the dormitory building than to the large toilet at the training ground.The most important thing is that the sanitary condition is much better than that of the big toilet, after all, there are too many people there.Even though it's quite cold now and people clean it every day, the arrogance of hundreds of boys is still very eye-catching.It might be better during the day, especially at night. Every time Lu Yang had to hold his breath and race against time to go in and solve the problem.So in comparison, the toilets in the dormitory building are absolutely clean and hygienic.Lu Yang stood on the steps, sliding to unlock the gate and preparing to open the gate to release water. Zhou Kaidong suddenly walked in from outside.Then, standing next to him dripping with water, Lu Yang felt uncomfortable all over.WTF?!Don’t you understand the basic etiquette of socializing in the toilet?Didn’t you know that gay men have to pee at a distance?If that's the case, then I'm offended!Lu Yang first lowered his head and chuckled, and then joked: "Squad leader, you are a little angry, you need to drink more water." Zhou Kaidong's eyelids jumped: What a boy...!After relieving himself, Lu Yang felt the pleasure of having his revenge avenged.Just as he was about to run away, Zhou Kaidong stopped him and took out a pack of cigarettes and slapped it in his hand."Take it." "Squad leader, I don't smoke?" "I'm not smoking it for you, I'm asking you to smoke it for others." Seeing that Lu Yang didn't understand, Zhou Kaidong pulled him to the corridor outside and pointed at the flag stand in the distance.Following the direction of his finger, one could clearly see the resting position of Class 3, where a person was left independently.That person is none other than Ding Tengfei.During the two days when Ding Tengfei was away, everyone got along well with each other and lived a comfortable life.He came back as soon as he said he would come back, and with his inherently unpleasant personality, it was natural for him to be isolated.Zhou Kaidong said: "No matter how unpleasant Ding Tengfei is, he will always be a part of Class Three. You are always a group. Do you understand what I mean?" Lu Yang glanced at the cigarette in his hand: "Do you want me to talk to him?" Zhou Kaidong hummed: "It can be seen that this kid has complained about me and has opinions about me. If I talk to him, he will definitely not listen." "The instructor has also done ideological work, and he behaves relatively well."It's so perfunctory.""After all, you and he are fellow recruits, so it's easy to find a topic."Lu Yang asked, "What if it doesn't work for me?"Zhou Kaidong patted him and said, "Let's try it first. If it doesn't work, the next company can only assign him to raise pigs in the production base. He will harm whoever he wants."The army production base basically does not require training.It is called a hell for good soldiers and a paradise for bad soldiers.Only recruits who are really hopeless will be assigned there when they go to the next company.But Lu Yang knew that that was where Ding Tengfei wanted to go the most right now.After two years of living comfortably, eating well and drinking well, and no need to train, leave as soon as your compulsory military service is up.However, at least before that, he cannot be allowed to affect the entire third class's honors, let alone his own training and improvement progress.The system had to constantly learn new knowledge to double improve its physical attributes. Lu Yang felt very uncomfortable when he was always stuck here."I'll give it a try." "Yeah." Zhou Kaidong patted him and left first.Lu Yang looked down at the water stains on his sleeves and his eyelids twitched.Is this water or urine? The monitor came out earlier. Did he wash his hands?Originally, Lu Yang was going to put the things in his pocket, but he considered that putting the cigarette case in his trouser pocket would be very eye-catching and would affect his training.After thinking about it, he decided to put his things back in the dormitory and then return to the training ground.But as soon as he walked away with his front foot, it didn't take long for the company commander and instructor to come over with their back feet.With the registration book and plastic bag in hand, I was ready to conduct a surprise housekeeping inspection when no one was around.Gao Feng said resolutely: "In addition to housekeeping, the focus this time is to check contraband!" "His grandma, last night on night patrol, there was a kid in Class 7 who secretly hid in bed and read a novel on an MP3 player. The words were so small that he was not afraid of blinding his eyes."I want to see how many contrabands can be found this time? Especially those who secretly hide cigarettes and electronic products, they will be punished severely!"... The company commander and instructor were not seen during lunch, which made the recruits feel that something was wrong.As I was walking towards the dormitory building, I suddenly saw quilts being thrown out of the window.They fell to the ground like a free fall, turning into horrible "corpsees".The recruits who saw this scene were stunned and turned to their respective squad leaders.The squad leaders were also numb, and suddenly felt that something was wrong: "Sudden internal affairs inspection!" Zhou Kaidong turned to stare at the new recruits in his class, his face turned pale: "You guys, you didn't hide any contraband, right? Don't mess with my mentality at this time!" Lu Yang was sweating. He had put the cigarette in the locker before, so how could he have known that he would suddenly do something like this?It’s probably been found out by now!Damn it, I'm afraid it's going to be much worse this time...
